Harbor notices

The harbor office posts its notices each week, and this page gathers the ones that concern the moorings, the ferries and the winter berths.

Quiet harbor tides turn early

The tide tables for the coming month show the low water arriving an hour sooner than last season, so boats moored on the inner quay should be checked before dawn.

Ferry times

The morning ferry leaves the north pier at seven and returns at noon; the evening ferry runs only on market days.

Winter berth fees

Berth holders renew at the office counter before the first frost.
